candidate.name: Continual Policy Optimization (CPO)
candidate.paper: RL Forgets! Towards Continual Policy Optimization
candidate.scope: multimodal reasoning continual post-training with five explicit sequential tasks on Qwen3-VL 2B/4B/8B; not evidence for boundary-free continual learning

paper_mechanism.selection: global TopP over all d parameter coordinates by absolute realized movement
paper_mechanism.cumulative_support: union current global TopP support with prior protected support
paper_mechanism.regularizer: lambda / M times the global sum of absolute deviations over all M protected coordinates
paper_mechanism.theory_scope: movement-to-Fisher relation is derived under a locally stationary SGD-style approximation with coordinate coefficients whose heterogeneity must be controlled for ranking consistency

release_code_contract.selection: for every floating state_dict tensor independently, k=floor(numel*p/100) and torch.topk is applied within that tensor; zero-movement selected entries are dropped; previous masks are unioned tensor-wise
release_code_contract.regularizer: for each protected tensor t independently, add lambda/m_t times sign(theta-reference) on its m_t protected coordinates, then sum tensor contributions
release_code_contract.optimizer_and_schedule: AdamW, weight_decay=0.1, cosine LR, warmup_ratio=0.1; ZeRO-3 with CPU parameter and optimizer offload in the published launchers
release_code_contract.mask_serialization: dense BoolTensor mask per protected parameter tensor plus float32 reference values at all cumulative protected positions

paper_release_mismatches.release_code: per-tensor TopP independently; code explicitly states no global threshold
paper_release_mismatches.mechanistic_consequence: release code forces approximately p-percent protection inside each sufficiently large tensor rather than allowing protection to concentrate in globally high-movement tensors

paper_release_mismatches.derived_coordinate_gradient_ratio: for a nonzero protected deviation in tensor t, |g_release|/|g_paper| = M/m_t
paper_release_mismatches.derived_total_regularizer_l1_gradient_bu: paper is approximately lambda over all protected coordinates; release code is approximately lambda times the number of protected tensors, assuming nonzero deviations
paper_release_mismatches.mechanistic_consequence: small protected tensors can receive much larger per-coordinate regularization than the paper objective

paper_release_mismatches.release_training: AdamW with weight decay, warmup and cosine schedule under RL noise
paper_release_mismatches.interpretation: not an implementation bug; it limits how directly realized movement should be interpreted as Fisher importance in the released experiments

reported_results_scope.interpretation_guard: These reported paper gains are evidence for the named experimental recipe, but without historical masks/checkpoints or an author clarification they cannot yet be causally attributed specifically to the paper equations rather than the later public release-code contract.

storage_cost_model.status: derived estimate, not measured from released mask artifacts
assumptions: dense torch.bool mask costs approximately one byte per coordinate
reference values are saved as float32, four bytes per protected coordinate
example model parameter count approximated as 8.8 billion solely for order-of-magnitude illustration
storage_cost_model.guard: Actual overlap, exact float-parameter count, torch serialization overhead and saved-file behavior must be measured before reporting realized storage.

matched_factorial_test.purpose: separate the effect of support selection topology from normalization topology
fixed_conditions: fair lambda tuning under matched validation/compute
measurements: regularizer gradient norm relative to RL gradient
per-step runtime and host-device transfer overhead

open_frontier: Run or obtain the 2x2 CPO factorial comparison before attributing gains to the paper mechanism.
Measure actual released-code mask/ref storage and runtime overhead on a tractable Qwen3-VL scale.
Search for author checkpoints/masks/logs or clarification that ties paper tables to paper-spec versus release-code-spec.
Resume DeMix/OpenCompass Track A1 when a networked Linux/Python-3.10 dependency-resolution environment is available.
Continue other role-local continual-learning branches with exact tested scope.
